text:
lina: Heads up — ap-south-2b GPU pool showing a burst of correctable ECCs over the last 12m, ~40 cards above baseline :rotating_light:

matt: which pool? full cluster id?

lina: pool=ap-south-2b-gpu-pool7, nodes affected scattered across racks 10-14. alert fired at 2063912240.

rahul: can you paste the prom query/results?

lina: prom query I ran: ```promql
sort_desc(sum by(card) (increase(gpu_ecc_correctable_total[10m])))
```
sample output (card, inc10m):
card-10: 48
card-14: 42
card-23: 38
card-32: 36
card-41: 35
...

emma: dmesg / XID? any kernel logs?

lina: short dmesg snippet from node-10: ```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 43, pid=0, 0x00000008
[ 1234.568001] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00: Warning: GPU reported ECC correctable
```

matt: hmm, looks like a region-wide correlated noise spike rather than isolated card flop. timeline aligns with scheduled power cycling on rack 12 at 2063912100?

rahul: confirmed — infra change window executed for UPS switchover at ~2063912055 in ap-south-2b. could be thermal/power transient.

emma: two fronts: 1) immediate mitigation to preserve customer SLOs, 2) followup hardware triage. we should avoid wholesale auto-drain until we understand correlation with power window.

lina: proposed emergency mitigation: "staggered quarantine" runbook — instead of immediate soft-drain, mark suspect cards as QUARANTINE for 12 minutes, route low-priority jobs away, keep high-p99 latency-critical requests on separate healthy cards. if errors continue after quarantine window escalate to soft-drain + replace.

matt: +1. we also need cheap capacity to absorb reroutes. spin up 8 GPUs from reserved pool (dedicated-reserve) and bias scheduler to use them for best-effort jobs.

gpu-bot: Automated rule matched: ecc_rate > 30/min/card over 5m in ap-south-2b-gpu-pool7. Triggering quarantine_automaton v0.4. Actions queued: mark_quarantine(12m), notify-ops.

rahul: operational checklist I'd run now:
- run xid-scan script on nodes in racks 10-14: `scripts/xid-scan --nodes node-10..node-14 --output /tmp/xid-206391`
- enable quarantine window 12m for cards with inc10m >= 30
- spin up 8 reserved GPUs, tag them `spillover:ap-south-2b-reserve`
- route best-effort tasks to spillover, leave latency-critical pinned to healthy labels
- collect ECC histogram and SNR baseline for last 24h and compare to 7d

emma: cost note: spinning reserved GPUs is cheaper than cross-region egress but check burst quotas. also routing heavy jobs to other regions increases cost/latency. ops, confirm we have spare reserved capacity.

matt: I'll check reserved pool. if not enough -> fallback is to throttle batch jobs (reduce concurrency) and move some to queued state.

lina: I'm kicking off xid-scan and enabling quarantine now. output to /var/tmp/xid-206391.log.

(5m later)

lina: xid-scan results: 16 nodes showed transient Xid 43 in last 15m, mostly on node-10..node-13. errors drop to baseline ~6m into quarantine for ~60% of cards. 40% continue to produce occasional correctables.

rahul: that pattern fits transient power/thermal noise. recommended next steps: extend quarantine to 30m for the 40% persistent cards, schedule hardware swap ticket for those cards, capture serial numbers and contact hw team.

matt: decision? drain now or wait for 30m?

emma: wait 30m for quarantine on persistent cards, but immediately tag for priority HW swap and create support case. Also adjust alert sensitivity: move to SNR-adjusted threshold so short transient spikes don't page on-call.

ops-runbook-bot: New incident created: INC-206391 — "ap-south-2b ECC transient spike; quarantine in progress". Assigned: infra-oncall. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ecc-transient-quarantine

lina: action items (assigned):
- lina: continue monitoring, collect full 24h histograms and SNR baselines.
- matt: reserve/spin up GPUs or throttle batch if reserve not available.
- rahul: prepare hw swap ticket for persistent cards with serials attached.
- emma: update alerting thresholds: implement SNR-adjusted suppression rule (5m window) and add dashboard panel for quarantine state.

matt: I'm provisioning 8 reserved GPUs now. ETA ~6m.

lina: thanks — so final runbook for this thread:
1) quarantine (12m) -> evaluate xid-scan results
2) if >30% of cards in a node still have inc10m >= 30 after quarantine -> extend quarantine to 30m + schedule HW swap
3) if errors persist >90m -> soft-drain node and replace cards
4) update alerts to use SNR-adjusted baseline and annotate incident with power window correlation

rahul: one more: add a periodic job to simulate power transient in staging to validate quarantine heuristics.

emma: agreed. also log cost estimate for spillover: ~+$120/hr if we spill to reserved across current burst.

lina: marking this thread as the live decision log. will post postmortem notes once we close incident. :white_check_mark:

matt: :thumbsup:
